items.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: Han Bennink, that famous beautiful Dutch drummer. He said, “Ingrid, I can’t go to the U.S. anymore.

ctx.x: So now, I just went to Berlin. We did — there is this big concert for Eric Dolphy. We were one of the few people that did the last concert with him, for one night, and then he died of sugar. And Han Bennink, that famous beautiful Dutch drummer. He said, “Ingrid, I can’t go to the U.S. anymore. It was my favorite trip. I can’t pay $1,500.”
